name: unlocker-target-404
description: Web Unlocker against a url whose TARGET answers 404, recorded live 2026-09-23 with `format: "json"`. The envelope is 200 — Bright Data performed the unlock and bills it — and the target's own status is a FIELD (`status_code: 404`). This is the chain that pins design D4: a target 4xx is billable success, not a provider error, so evidence settles `{CALL: 1}` and `isProviderError` stays false.
